name: uniQure N.V.
blurb: uniQure N.V. is a Dutch clinical-stage gene therapy company headquartered in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with U.S. operations in Lexington, Massachusetts. The company focuses on developing one-time gene therapies for severe genetic diseases using its proprietary AAV-based platform. Its first approved product, Hemgenix (etranacogene dezaparvovec), received FDA approval in November 2022 for hemophilia B — the most expensive drug ever approved at launch — and is commercialized through a partnership with CSL Behring. Its pipeline is led by AMT-130, a gene therapy targeting Huntington's disease in Phase I/II trials.
